in_marathi.name: Malathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Garland of flowers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Malathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Malathi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'malati', which means 'garland of flowers'. In Hindu mythology, Malathi is the name of a goddess who is believed to bestow beauty, grace, and good fortune. She is often depicted wearing a garland of flowers and is a symbol of love, devotion, and fertility.
